import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import urllib.request

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
state = json.loads((root/'artifacts/reactor-manual-services.json').read_text())
raw = (root/'artifacts/handshake-inline-browser-eval.txt').read_text()
browser = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw.split('### Result\n',1)[1])[0]
assert browser['passed'] and browser['finished'] and len(browser['checks']) == 7 and not browser['errors']
runtime = {}
for index, role in enumerate(['native','bridge']):
    pid = state['pids'][index]
    runtime[role] = {'pid':pid,'sha256':sha(f'/proc/{pid}/exe'),'command':state['commands'][index]}
    assert runtime[role]['sha256'] == state[f'{role}_sha256']
def get(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=3) as response:
        return response.status, response.read()
health = {label:get(url)[0] for label,url in {
    'healthz':'http://127.0.0.1:1339/healthz','readyz':'http://127.0.0.1:1339/readyz',
    'browser':'http://127.0.0.1:4180/'}.items()}
assert all(status == 200 for status in health.values())
_, body = get('http://127.0.0.1:1339/metrics')
metrics = {key:int(value) for key,value in (line.split() for line in body.decode().splitlines() if line.startswith('war_'))}
for key in ['war_connections','war_sessions','war_queued_bytes','war_variable_bytes','war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes',
            'war_close_failures_total','war_transport_disconnects_total','war_write_errors_total','war_routing_copied_bytes_total']:
    assert metrics[key] == 0
assert metrics['war_joined_total'] == metrics['war_disconnected_total'] == 3
inodes = set()
for fd in Path(f'/proc/{state["pids"][0]}/fd').iterdir():
    try:
        match = re.fullmatch(r'socket:\[(\d+)\]',str(fd.readlink()))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        continue
    if match:
        inodes.add(match[1])
listeners = [row.split() for row in Path('/proc/net/tcp').read_text().splitlines()[1:]
             if row.split()[9] in inodes and row.split()[3] == '0A' and row.split()[1].endswith(':053A')]
assert len(listeners) == 4
screenshot = root/'output/playwright/handshake-inline-browser-check.png'
report = {'passed':True,'source_revision':state['source_revision'],'browser':browser,'runtime':runtime,
    'health':health,'metrics':metrics,'worker_listener_sockets':len(listeners),'listener_rows':listeners,
    'screenshot':{'path':str(screenshot.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(screenshot)},
    'browser_assets':{str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in sorted((root/'target/browser').iterdir()) if p.is_file()},
    'eval_output':{'path':'artifacts/handshake-inline-browser-eval.txt','sha256':sha(root/'artifacts/handshake-inline-browser-eval.txt')},
    'collector_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-handshake-inline-browser.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'checks':len(browser['checks']),'source':state['source_revision'],'listeners':len(listeners),'health':health,'resources_zero':True}))
